plugins.name: skilldrop
plugins.description: Portable AI-agent skills for the deliverables knowledge workers ship — diagrams, ADRs, PRDs, runbooks, decks, reviews — installable into Claude Code, Cursor, Kiro, and any IDE that takes custom instructions. One command per skill or per role-based pack.

plugins.name: solution-architect
plugins.description: Design-phase artifacts: diagrams, decision records, design docs, contracts, schemas, threat models, and the reviews that gate them. (17 skills)

plugins.name: product-manager
plugins.description: Direction to requirements: PR/FAQs, strategy frameworks, OKRs, PRDs, journey maps, story splitting, and success measurement. (13 skills)

plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: Build-and-ship loop: story implementation with adversarial review, test plans, triage, migrations, release notes, agent-policy files, and code-quality gates. (14 skills)

plugins.name: sre-oncall
plugins.description: Operate the service: runbooks, observability design, incident communications, postmortems, and capacity/cost models. (5 skills)

plugins.name: stakeholder-comms
plugins.description: Non-technical audiences: audience profiling, deck outlines and real .pptx decks, exec summaries, decision logs, and guides. (9 skills)

plugins.name: ai-engineering
plugins.description: Adopt and build AI systems: readiness assessment, use-case triage, rollout and acceptable-use policy, plus agent loop design, subagent orchestration, spend budgets, agent security review, eval harnesses, AI-usage reporting, and the data contracts AI pipelines depend on. (12 skills)
